data.exact_reserve_text: There were favourable movements during the year of GBP 28.9m (2014: GBP 24.8m), on prior year gross claims reserves, held at 31 December 2014.
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate closed 2014 with gross claims outstanding of GBP 116.166m (opening for 2015). During 2015 there were favourable movements on prior year gross claims reserves totalling GBP 28.9m (a release), representing approximately 24.9% of the opening gross claims outstanding. The syndicate's business is predominantly third-party liability (casualty), and the release reflects favourable claims development across prior years as reported in the Technical Provisions note.
raw_causal_phrases: There were favourable movements during the year of GBP 28.9m (2014: GBP 24.8m), on prior year gross claims reserves, held at 31 December 2014.
data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from the Statement of Financial Position (Claims outstanding 2014 column). Prior year development taken from Technical Provisions note sentence explicitly stating 'favourable movements ... GBP 28.9m' (gross). The syndicate writes predominantly employers' and public liability (mapped to 'Casualty') - attribution of the aggregate prior year release to Casualty is an inference. A gross claims development triangle (page 40) is present and was not required to compute the prior year movement but is provided for cross-check.
